review_scope: Independent read-only review of the exact E520-v7 source, worker, packet builder, plan, integration tests, and bundle coverage. This is source/code review only; it is not provider admission and does not authorize or evidence packet submission, profile execution, fit, prediction, grading, or score.
findings: Digest reuse is limited to the exact raw train/valid files discovered under the read-only Kaggle input mount. The helper accepts only canonical allowlisted regular files and verifies descriptor/path identity around the complete byte-stream hash; cache authorization follows equality with both the frozen expected digest and pinned portable-registry digest.

The worker writes observed input identity and verifies parquet footer, expected digest/byte count, portable manifest, and source-module identity before authorizing reuse. It then wraps only the pinned portability module's _content_digest before the first split load. The registry checks remain active and wnn.splits.file_sha256 is unchanged. A stale or mutated stat identity evicts the cache entry and falls back to the original full digest; a synthetic same-size mutation check confirmed the pinned verifier rejects changed content.

The profile recipe, input/fold/target identities, model and training settings, and resource/headroom thresholds are unchanged from the reviewed v6 profile-only attempt. The 1,700-second worker wall cap matches the plan and builder/worker constants. The worker remains a bounded profile/shape diagnostic and does not fit, export predictions, or score.

GPU telemetry inventories all physical GPUs and records each device's identity, memory, and utilization fields. N/A values remain null; query errors and malformed output are retained as diagnostics rather than converted to zero. Sampling is bounded and stopped in the trainer cleanup path; tests cover multi-device rows, N/A, query failure, and pre/post samples.

The deterministic self-contained kernel bundle includes every reviewed runtime file and tests the reviewed-set-to-payload coverage invariant. Exact review-target-only generation reproduced the frozen map and created no packet. The frozen v6 transport shape is retained with the v7 code; no packet or provider operation was performed during this review.
